units.source_text: 舞乐《兰陵王》又名《没日还午乐》，

en.t: The bugaku piece "Prince of Lanling" is also called "Music of the Setting Sun Returning to Noon,"

units.source_text: 其中有一奏法曰“日招返”。

en.t: and one of its performance techniques is called "Calling Back the Sun."
The idea of beckoning the sun with a plectrum was probably based on this.
